question: How did Chandrayaan travel to the moon? 🚀
explanation: Awesome! Spacecrafts like Chandrayaan travel to space on powerful rockets! 🚀
hint: It flies super fast up into the sky.

question: Where did Chandrayaan land safely? 🌕
explanation: Great job! Chandrayaan made a very safe landing on the beautiful moon! 🌕
hint: It shines brightly at night.

question: Which country sent Chandrayaan to space? 🇮🇳
explanation: Super! India is very proud of sending Chandrayaan to the moon! 🇮🇳
hint: It is our lovely home country.

question: What does the word 'Chandrayaan' mean? 🚙
explanation: Fantastic! 'Chandra' means moon and 'yaan' means vehicle. 🚙
hint: It is a car that goes to the moon.

question: What is the name of our home planet? 🌍
explanation: Excellent! We all live together on the beautiful blue planet Earth. 🌍
hint: It has lots of blue water and green land.

question: Who works hard to build rockets? 👩‍🔬
explanation: Brilliant! Very smart scientists build rockets and plan space missions. 👩‍🔬
hint: They work in laboratories and wear white coats.

question: What shines brightly with the moon at night? ⭐
explanation: Awesome! Millions of tiny stars twinkle in the night sky. ✨
hint: They twinkle twinkle up high.

question: What does Chandrayaan do on the moon? 📸
explanation: Great job! Chandrayaan uses cameras to take amazing pictures of the moon. 📸
hint: You use a camera to do this.

question: What did the scientists feel when it landed? 😃
explanation: Super! Everyone was so happy and clapped their hands loudly! 👏
hint: They smiled a big smile.

question: What colour is the sky at night? 🌌
explanation: Fantastic! The night sky is dark so we can see the glowing stars! 🌌
hint: It is the colour of outer space.

question: What do astronauts wear in space? 👩‍🚀
explanation: Excellent! Spacesuits keep astronauts safe while they float in space! 👩‍🚀
hint: It is a big white suit with a helmet.

question: What sound does a rocket make when it flies? 🔊
explanation: Brilliant! Rockets go zoom zoom very loudly as they fly up! 🚀
hint: It is a loud rushing sound.

question: What does the moon look like when it is full? ⚪
explanation: Awesome! A full moon looks like a bright, glowing white circle. 🌕
hint: It looks like a round ball.

question: What comes out from the bottom of a rocket? 🔥
explanation: Great job! Powerful fire pushes the rocket high into the sky! 🔥
hint: It is very hot and bright.

question: What did Chandrayaan look for on the moon? 💧
explanation: Super! Scientists want to know if there is water frozen on the moon. 💧
hint: We drink it every day.

question: Is there any air to breathe on the moon? 🌬️
explanation: Fantastic! Space has no air, so astronauts take oxygen with them. 👩‍🚀
hint: You cannot fly a kite there.

question: What goes round and round the Earth? 🌕
explanation: Excellent! The moon loves to travel around our Earth all the time! 🌍
hint: We see it glowing at night.

question: Are there any tall trees on the moon? 🌳
explanation: Brilliant! The moon has no plants or trees, just rocks and dust. 🪨
hint: There is no water or soil for them to grow.

question: What is the surface of the moon like? 🪨
explanation: Awesome! The moon is covered in grey rocks and lots of dust! 🪨
hint: It is hard and grey.

question: How far away is the moon from Earth? 📏
explanation: Great job! The moon is very far, so rockets take days to reach it. 🚀
hint: You cannot walk there.

question: Who is very proud of Chandrayaan? 🇮🇳
explanation: Super! Everyone in India felt so happy and proud! 🇮🇳
hint: The people living in our country.

question: What do we use to see the moon from far away? 🔭
explanation: Fantastic! A telescope makes the faraway moon look very big and close! 🔭
hint: It is a long tube you look through.

question: What is the name of the moon rover? 🚙
explanation: Excellent! The brave little rover is named Pragyan! 🚙
hint: It starts with the letter P.

question: What is the name of the moon lander? 🛸
explanation: Brilliant! The lander Vikram carried the rover safely to the moon! 🛸
hint: It starts with the letter V.

question: How many wheels does the rover Pragyan have? 🛞
explanation: Awesome! Pragyan uses its six wheels to drive on the bumpy moon! 🚙
hint: Three on one side, three on the other.

question: What is a big group of stars called? ✨
explanation: Great job! A galaxy is a huge family of many, many stars! 🌌
hint: It is a beautiful swirl of light in space.

question: Who flies inside a rocket? 👨‍🚀
explanation: Super! Brave astronauts train hard to fly into space! 👩‍🚀
hint: They wear spacesuits.

question: Can birds fly to the moon? 🦅
explanation: Fantastic! Birds need air to fly, so they stay on Earth. 🌍
hint: Space has no air for their wings.

question: What gives light to the moon? ☀️
explanation: Excellent! The bright sun shines its light onto the moon! ☀️
hint: It is the biggest star we see in the day.

question: What do we say before a rocket flies? ⏰
explanation: Brilliant! We count down 3, 2, 1, and shout Blast Off! 🚀
hint: It means shooting up quickly.

question: Where do rockets blast off from? 🏗️
explanation: Awesome! A launchpad is a special safe place for rockets to fly from! 🚀
hint: It is a very big flat ground.

question: How long did Chandrayaan take to reach the moon? 🗓️
explanation: Great job! It took many days of flying to travel that far! 🚀
hint: It takes more than a week.

question: What shape is a crescent moon? 🌙
explanation: Super! A crescent moon looks like a beautiful glowing banana in the sky! 🌙
hint: It is curved and thin.

question: What organization in India made Chandrayaan? 🏢
explanation: Fantastic! ISRO is India's amazing space agency! 🇮🇳
hint: It stands for Indian Space Research Organisation.

question: What flag was on the Chandrayaan rocket? 🇮🇳
explanation: Excellent! The rocket proudly carried our beautiful Indian flag! 🇮🇳
hint: It has saffron, white, and green colours.

question: What is bigger in size? 🌍
explanation: Brilliant! The Earth is much, much bigger than the moon! 🌍
hint: It is the planet we live on.

question: What pulls the rocket back to Earth? 🧲
explanation: Awesome! Gravity is like a big invisible magnet pulling things down! 🌍
hint: It is what makes a ball fall when you drop it.

question: Do we hear sounds on the moon? 🔇
explanation: Great job! Space is completely quiet because there is no air! 🔇
hint: It is very, very silent.

question: What do we call a big hole on the moon? 🕳️
explanation: Super! The moon has many round bowls called craters! 🌕
hint: It looks like a giant dent.

question: What color are the clouds on Earth? ☁️
explanation: Fantastic! Earth has fluffy white clouds floating in the sky. ☁️
hint: They look like cotton candy.

question: What does the Earth look like from space? 🔵
explanation: Excellent! Earth looks like a beautiful blue marble from space! 🌍
hint: It is round and has lots of oceans.

question: What did people do when the rocket went up? 👏
explanation: Brilliant! Everyone cheered and clapped for the rocket! 🎉
hint: They hit their hands together.

question: What time of day do we usually see the stars? 🌃
explanation: Awesome! When the sun goes down, the beautiful stars come out! ✨
hint: It is dark outside.

question: Can we live on the moon right now? 🏠
explanation: Great job! We cannot live there yet because there is no air or water. 🌍
hint: We still need to build special houses there.

question: What does the sun do every morning? 🌅
explanation: Super! The bright sun rises in the morning to wake us up! ☀️
hint: It comes up into the sky.

question: How does a spacesuit help astronauts? 🛡️
explanation: Fantastic! A spacesuit protects them and gives them air to breathe! 👩‍🚀
hint: It acts like a strong shield.

question: What is very hot and big in space? ☀️
explanation: Excellent! The sun is a giant star that gives us heat and light! ☀️
hint: You cannot look directly at it.

question: What covers a lot of the Earth? 🌊
explanation: Brilliant! Big blue oceans of water cover most of our planet! 🌍
hint: Fish live in it.

question: Will India send more rockets to space? 🚀
explanation: Awesome! Indian scientists will keep exploring the magical space! 🇮🇳
hint: They love to learn new things.

question: Who can be a space scientist when they grow up? 👧
explanation: Great job! If you study hard, YOU can build rockets too! 🚀
hint: All smart kids have a chance.
